title: a rule set
description: One rule set, rules/<name>.json: enforced permission rules, the permission part of what .claude/settings.json holds. A rule set carries limits, never behaviour.

allow.description: Tool rules that are allowed without asking.

items.description: One rule, such as Bash(git status). Must not be empty.

deny.description: Not allowed in a factory: the check refuses every deny rule, because the owner must always be able to approve. Write the rule under ask instead.

items.description: One rule, such as Bash(git push:*). Must not be empty.

ask.description: Tool rules that stop the seat and ask a person each time. This is how a factory restricts a seat.

items.description: One rule. Must not be empty.
